name: Sauna Guide Quotes
tagline: Prepare a US home sauna quote request and submit it only after explicit approval
description: Remote MCP from Sauna Guide, an independent home sauna buying guide. The read-only prepare tool validates a project brief (ZIP, project type, heat type, budget, timeline, contact details) and lists what is missing without storing anything. A separate submit tool sends the unchanged brief to Sauna Guide only after the user explicitly approves it. Free, no authentication, Streamable HTTP.
